name: Mini Doubt: Usotsuki Onna Hen
original_name: ミニダウト 嘘つきオンナ編
source:
The first chapter in the Doubt series where the protagonist is male!

Our protagonist is a hard-working researcher who has never had time for romance. After his father collapses, he starts thinking seriously about finding a marriage partner but... he's surrounded by women who are secretly liars! Will he find his happy ending?
translation:
《Doubt》系列的第一章，主人公是男性！

主人公是一名勤奋的研究员，从来没有时间谈恋爱。父亲倒下后，他开始认真考虑寻找结婚对象，可……他身边的女人全都是暗中说谎的骗子！他能找到幸福的结局吗？
